scope: Full application development comparison against an unsharpened conventional stack, not ground truth or scientific qualification.

baseline.role: development comparison; reference is not ground truth
baseline.registration_method: Gaussian 1.5px amplitude correlation with subpixel peak fit + confidence-gated normalized local patches

local_alignment.template: mean of valid aligned candidates, origin anchored to the selected best frame

candidate.role: development comparison; reference is not ground truth
candidate.registration_method: Gaussian 1.5px amplitude correlation with subpixel peak fit + confidence-gated normalized local patches

local_alignment.template: mean of valid aligned candidates, origin anchored to the selected best frame
local_alignment.registration_proxy: bilinear RGB luminance (0.25 R + 0.5 G + 0.25 B)

protocol: Same 3341 screened frames of 3749, identical cached scalar quality weights, best-frame coordinate anchor 1947 and all 64 template candidate indices. Only the eligible experimental Bayer local-alignment registration proxy changes to bilinear RGB luminance. Raw CFA accumulation, local confidence/fold guards, frame selection and sharpening settings unchanged.

validation.integration: Integrated full application image, coverage and validity reproduced the pre-integration full candidate bitwise.
validation.colour_and_cache: All four Bayer layouts preserve constant colour. Exact Bayer checkpoint resume and unchanged preprocessing cache bytes verified. Version-1 green-template local checkpoints rejected; ordinary global and small-capture fallback outputs remain unchanged.
validation.visual: Inspected the full exported unsharpened RGB result and conventional reference; no visible CFA lattice or missing colour channel.

decision: Adopted within the existing experimental local alignment option for eligible Bayer captures. Global alignment and all-screened defaults stay unchanged. Full-capture gains are small (0.086% lower matched RMS and 0.000294 higher fine-detail correlation), and colour proxy construction adds processing cost. Weak red/blue controls do not show a consistent gain; no universal-benefit claim.
timing_note: Wall times are descriptive, not isolated performance benchmarks. The integrated replay overlapped CPU regression tests; the per-frame luminance helper is more expensive than the green helper.
